subject: Learning Methods
title: What Drives Intrinsic Motivation
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on What Drives Intrinsic Motivation.

hook.text: Children solve puzzles for hours with no reward. Adults quit tasks the moment payment stops. What changed?

buildup.text: Intrinsic motivation is the drive to do something because it's inherently interesting or satisfying.

discovery.text: Deci and Ryan's self-determination theory identifies three needs: autonomy, competence, and relatedness.

twist.text: External rewards can actually destroy intrinsic motivation. Paying someone for a hobby can turn joy into obligation.

climax.text: Protect your intrinsic curiosity. Choose topics that genuinely interest you.

punchline.text: Autonomy, competence, relatedness. Those fuel real drive.

quiz.question: What three needs fuel intrinsic motivation according to self-determination theory?
